rationale: The agent did perform user lookup (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details), but then executed multiple order-changing writes without any explicit user confirmation: two order cancellations (#W9373487 and #W5481803) and two returns (orders #W2692684 item 3788616824 and #W7449508 item 6477915553). Policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it, and the user explicitly prefers one thing at a time. Additionally, the user asked for the tablet’s tracking number and whether a refund/reorder could be done for a lost tablet; there’s no evidence the agent provided a tracking number, discussed refund/reorder options, or handed off to a human if needed. The returns also exceed the user’s request (user only asked to return the sneaker, but two separate returns were processed). The closing message suggests the agent concluded without addressing these gaps. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass bar.
